# ComfyUI venv (/workspace/h3/venv): packages that used to come from the Vast base image's
# system Python while the venv was created with --system-site-packages. The venv is now
# self-contained; these pins are installed into it right after torch and ComfyUI requirements
# (and used as constraints for them), so a newer vastai/base-image cannot change them.
#
# Lives in the base bundle (vendor/minimax-h3-local-studio) because deploy_h3_local_studio.sh creates
# the venv; scripts/deploy_h3_new_server.sh ships it to the overlay too. Applied by
# h3_comfy_venv_isolate (scripts/h3_gpu_env.sh).
#
# Versions = the approved server snapshot h3-20261004-1826 (lock/venv.txt). Only what
# ComfyUI b5cc8830, its requirements, our 6 custom nodes (h3_native_helpers, FirstBlockCache,
# h3-3D-camera-guide, h3-color-grade, h3-character-refine incl. sam2/iopath/hydra, websocket_image_save)
# and torch/torchvision/transformers/huggingface-hub actually import. Found with `pip check` in a
# venv without system packages + a CPU ComfyUI start on the local stand (docs/H3_GOLDEN_IMAGE_PLAN.md).
# Deliberately absent: jupyter/notebook/tornado/twisted/tensorboard and other base-image tooling.
